# RedTeam Go + QuickBooks Integration Enhancements

- 5 MIN READ
- March 18, 2026

# **RedTeam Go + QuickBooks Integration Enhancements**

**Stronger Accounting Workflows. Less Manual Work. Better Financial Accuracy.**

We’re introducing a new set of enhancements to the **QuickBooks integration in RedTeam Go** designed to improve how construction teams manage accounting data between operations and finance. These updates expand automation, improve payroll and time tracking alignment, and make it easier for companies managing multiple entities to connect their accounting systems.

Together, these improvements reduce manual data entry, ensure cleaner job cost data in QuickBooks, and give accounting teams greater confidence that financial information is synced correctly between systems.

## **Why These Enhancements Matter**

Construction companies rely on accurate, timely financial data to manage job costs, payroll, billing, and vendor payments. When operations and accounting systems aren’t fully aligned, teams often spend hours reconciling data manually.

These QuickBooks enhancements strengthen the connection between RedTeam Go and QuickBooks by:

- Reducing duplicate data entry
- Improving job cost accuracy
- Supporting payroll workflows
- Allowing multi-company accounting configurations
- Ensuring time tracking aligns with accounting requirements

The result is a more seamless workflow between project management and accounting teams.

# **Key Enhancements**

## **Multi-Company QuickBooks Integration**

Companies operating multiple entities can now configure separate QuickBooks connections for each company within RedTeam Go. This enhancement applies to **both QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online integrations**.

### **What This Means for Users**

- Each company in RedTeam Go can connect to its own QuickBooks account
- Integration settings now support **multiple accounting connections**
- Financial data flows to the correct accounting system automatically


### **Why It’s Important**

Many construction businesses operate multiple legal entities for liability, tax, or operational reasons. Previously, connecting multiple companies required workarounds. This enhancement enables **clean, scalable accounting integrations across all business entities**.

## **Enhanced Employee Time & Payroll Sync**

Time tracking in RedTeam Go now better aligns with how payroll data is processed in QuickBooks.

### **New Capability: Sync Non-Job Time Codes**

Users can now map **non-job time codes** such as:

- PTO
- Sick Time
- Holiday

to a default cost code that syncs with QuickBooks.

### **What This Means for Users**

- Payroll-related time entries sync correctly with accounting.
- Admins can configure mappings in QuickBooks integration settings
- Time that is not tied to a job still flows properly to accounting


### **Why It’s Important**

Construction payroll often includes both **job-costed labor and non-job time**. These enhancements ensure payroll data flows into QuickBooks without requiring manual correction or reclassification.

## **AP Transaction Sync Safeguards**

RedTeam Go now prevents duplicate AP transactions from being sent to QuickBooks and provides better visibility into sync activity.

### **What This Means for Users**

- Subcontractor Bills will no longer be accidentally resent to QuickBooks after additional approvals (e.g., lien releases or re-acceptance)
- The system checks for an existing QuickBooks reference before sending a Bill
- If a Bill has already been synced, it will not be sent again automatically
- Users can still manually resend a Bill when needed
- Sync activity now includes clearer logs showing when transactions are sent, skipped, or blocked
- Bills cannot be synced to closed accounting periods in QuickBooks


### **Why It’s Important**

Duplicate transactions in QuickBooks create confusion, require manual cleanup, and reduce trust in the integration. These safeguards ensure that Bills are only sent when appropriate, while still giving teams control to resend transactions when necessary. The result is cleaner accounting data, fewer errors, and more predictable integration behavior.

## **Purchase Orders & Commitment Integration Improvements**

RedTeam Go now supports earlier commitment tracking and improves how subcontractor billing ties to Purchase Orders in QuickBooks.

### **Enable Field Purchase Orders for Bidding & Pending Projects**

Field Purchase Orders can now be created and synced to QuickBooks even before a project is marked “In Progress.”

#### **What This Means for Users**

- Field POs can be approved and synced while a project is in Bidding or Pending status
- Users will be prompted to assign aproject numberif one does not exist
- The assigned project number becomes locked once used for syncing
- The project status will not automatically change when a PO is synced
- All existing approval workflows and validations remain unchanged


#### **Why It’s Important**

Construction teams often need to issue commitments early in the project lifecycle. This enhancement removes the need to prematurely move projects to “In Progress,” allowing teams to track commitments accurately while maintaining proper project status and accounting alignment.

### **Automatic Linking of Subcontractor Bills to Purchase Orders**

Subcontractor Bills will now automatically link to their corresponding Purchase Orders in QuickBooks.

#### **What This Means for Users**

- Bills exported to QuickBooks will automatically associate with the correct Subcontract PO
- PO balances will decrease as Bills are entered
- “Billed-to-date” and “remaining balance” values stay aligned between RedTeam Go and QuickBooks
- QuickBooks reports will accurately reflect commitment balances without duplication


#### **Why It’s Important**

When Bills are not tied to Purchase Orders, commitment tracking becomes unreliable and requires manual reconciliation. This enhancement ensures that both systems stay in sync, improving reporting accuracy and reducing accounting effort.

# **What Will Change for Users**

For most users, the transition will be seamless. However, administrators may notice:

**New Configuration Options**

- Expanded QuickBooks integration settings
- Ability to configure company-specific connections
- Mapping options for non-job time codes


**Improved System Behavior**

- Duplicate AP transactions are prevented automatically
- Bills and Purchase Orders stay properly linked
- Time tracking sync includes all employee hours
- Clearer sync logs provide better visibility into integration activity


**Reduced Manual Work**

- Fewer corrections in QuickBooks
- Less reconciliation between systems
- More reliable financial reporting

# **What to Expect after Release**

On **March 19**, these enhancements will be released to all RedTeam Go customers using the QuickBooks (Desktop and Online) integration.

### **Expected Changes**

- **No disruption to existing integrations** – current QuickBooks connections will remain active

- **New settings will be available** in the QuickBooks Integration Settings page

- **Optional configuration updates** may be required to take full advantage of:
  - Multi-company integrations
  - Non-job time code mappings
- **Improved sync behavior** for employee time and payroll-related entries will begin immediately after release


### **Recommended Next Steps**

- Review your **QuickBooks Integration Settings** after March 19
- Configure mappings for any non-job time codes (PTO, Sick, Holiday)
- If managing multiple companies, connect each entity to its respective QuickBooks account

These updates are designed to be **backward compatible**, while giving your team more control and flexibility moving forward.
